root_cause: Public copy changed after the versioned English cache was proven. The new homepage and AI ecosystem copy introduced 126 translatable strings while production was intentionally cache-only, so the fail-closed build correctly rejected the incomplete cache. Historical regressions still expected network-backed production translation or runtime fallback.
prevention: Every public-copy change must include its versioned English translation patch in the same lineage.
Keep production translation authority cache-only with STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=0 and STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=1.
Run offline cache completeness before protected merge.
Do not reintroduce provider-backed production translation or Dutch-as-English fallback to make builds green.
